Attachment (01) to SAES — Scope of Work Requirements. FY19. Per-bay scope details; some differences in scope detail vs. BOD (e.g., truck ramp in Bay 1, expanded Bay 5 customer area).

fire_pump.quote: a fire pump is required. A 1,250 gpm 60 psi electric pump will be provided.

electrical_service_existing.value: Two separate electrical services: Service #1 = 300 KVA 11.5KV-208Y/120V with 800A MCB in Bay 3; Service #2 = 225 KVA 11.5KV-208Y/120V with exterior 800A MCB
electrical_service_existing.quote: The building currently has two separate electrical services. Service #1 consists of a 300 KVA, 11.5 KV-208Y/120 Volt, pad mounted transformer with overhead service cables, and an 800 Amp MCB, main distribution panel in Bay 3. Service #2 consists of a 225 KVA, 11.5 KV-208Y/120 Volt, pad mounted transformer and an exterior 800 Amp MCB, distribution panel mounted adjacent to the transformer.

electrical_service_proposed.value: Consolidate two services into one; retain 300 KVA transformer; add secondary lateral for 60 HP fire pump
electrical_service_proposed.quote: these two services will be combined into one. The existing overhead service lateral serving electrical service #2 MDP will be removed back to the exterior distribution panel. The existing 300 KVA pad mounted transformer and overhead service lateral serving electrical service #1 MDP will remain. An additional secondary service lateral will be provided from the 300 KVA pad mounted transformer to serve a new 60 HP fire pump.

hvac_scope.value: All existing mechanical systems demolished; new system: three heat pump split systems plus exhaust for restrooms and storage
hvac_scope.quote: All existing mechanical systems will be demolished complete... New system equipment shall include three heat pump split systems and associated piping; and an exhaust system for restroom and storage room ventilation.

corroboration.value: radiant heat in Bay 4 (additional to split systems)

plumbing_scope.value: Demo all existing plumbing in Bays 1 and 5; provide new restrooms, domestic water, DWV, electric water heaters, eyewash stations
plumbing_scope.quote: All existing plumbing systems shall be demolished. New rest rooms shall be constructed.
plumbing_scope.notes: Bay 1 and Bay 5 full plumbing demo and replacement. New fixtures: floor-mounted water closets, wall-mounted lavatories, urinals, countertop sinks, electric water heaters, emergency eyewash.

fire_protection_scope.value: New automatic sprinkler system (wet and dry pipe per area) throughout all five bays; new fire alarm and mass notification system; new fire pump (1,250 gpm / 60 psi electric)
fire_protection_scope.quote: Facility SDA-205 will be equipped with a fully automatic supervised wet-pipe and dry-pipe sprinkler system in all five bays.

corroboration.claim: Demolish existing and provide new Automatic Sprinkler System. Provide Fire Alarm and Mass Notification System. Provide new Fire Pump.

lighting_scope.value: Full demo of all interior and exterior lighting; new LED throughout including high bay, low bay, recessed, and pendant; wireless controls with daylight harvesting and occupancy sensors; battery backup emergency lighting
lighting_scope.quote: Demolish existing interior and exterior lighting throughout warehouse and administration spaces... Provide new interior and exterior lighting throughout warehouse and new administration spaces. Provide emergency and exit lighting. All new interior and exterior lighting will be LED.

corroboration.claim: Demolish and provide lighting with new LED lights.

telecommunications_scope.value: Existing outside plant cabling and telephone entrance room to remain; relocate one IT cabinet for new admin space; new Cat-6 outlets in new spaces
telecommunications_scope.quote: Existing copper and fiber optic outside plan cabling serving SDA-205 must remain. The existing Telephone Entrance Room located in Bay 1 administration area must remain.

access_control_scope.value: Access Control System (ACS) at personnel doors; card readers, keypads, door position switches, electronic strikes; reporting to base monitoring station
access_control_scope.quote: An Access Control System (ACS) will be provided at personnel doors in accordance with the RFP. Devices include, but are not limited to, card readers and keypads, door position switches, electronic door strikes, and system control panels. The system will report to the existing base monitoring station.

av_scope.value: Relocate existing VTC system from existing conference room to new conference/training room
av_scope.quote: The existing Video Teleconferencing (VTC) system located in the existing Customer Service/Office conference room will be relocated to the newly constructed Conference/Training room.

BOD represents the Final Design Submittal (3 March 2021), which postdates the SOW (August 2019). The quantity likely changed during design development. Chose BOD as later, more authoritative document.
